onboarding.description:
No active AI conversation agents (e.g. Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama) were found in your Home Assistant configuration.

Otis AI Companion requires an AI provider for voice/text interaction, spatial mapping, and automation suggestions. We recommend configuring the **Google Generative AI** or **OpenAI** integration first.

Would you like to proceed with limited local-only features?
